title: Cheap Martial Arts Software (2026): $0 to $79/mo Compared
description: Low-cost martial arts and BJJ software compared: MatPilot (free or $79), MatGoat ($40-$60), MAAT ($49-$59), BJJLink, GymPoint and RhinoFit, with fees.
h1: Cheap martial arts software: free and under-$80 options
body:
If you run a small dojo or BJJ academy, you don't need to pay $99 to $300 a month for software. Several newer tools publish flat prices between $0 and $79 a month with unlimited members on at least one plan. The catch is usually a payment fee, a student cap or a missing feature. We checked each vendor's own pricing page on November 9, 2026 and list only what they publish; anything not published is marked unknown. We haven't used these tools ourselves and we don't publish ratings.

{{table:matpilot,matgoat,maat,rhinofit,kicksite,pushpress}}

The low-cost options

  • MatPilot: Free plan at $0/mo plus a 2% platform fee on payments you take through it; Pro is $79/mo plus 0.49% with unlimited members, family billing, diplomas and Xero. Stripe's own card fee applies on both. No setup fee, no per-member fee, month to month. The pricing page says Free is "for small academies" but doesn't state a member limit. Add-ons are optional: a phone line ($25/mo plus calls), an in-app store ($39/mo, or $29/mo + 1.5% a sale) and a website (+$25/mo on Pro). {{aff:matpilot|See MatPilot pricing}}
  • MatGoat: Basic is $40/mo for up to 50 students and Professional is $60/mo for unlimited students. Payment management (fees, reminders, billing) is on Professional only. MatGoat says it adds no percentage to student payments, so you pay only Stripe's fees. Both plans include kiosk check-in, belt and level history, private videos and messaging. 30-day trial with no credit card and a 30-day money-back guarantee. {{aff:matgoat|See MatGoat pricing}}
  • MAAT: one plan with all features and unlimited members at $59/mo, or $49/mo paid annually, plus a 1% transaction fee on top of Stripe fees. No contract on the monthly plan, a 7-day free trial, and free data migration. Built for BJJ and MMA gyms, with stripe and belt promotion tracking. MAAT's terms say prices may show in EUR or GBP depending on your location. {{aff:maat|See MAAT pricing}}
  • RhinoFit: a flat $57/mo with no member limits, or a $0 start-up plan for 20 or fewer active users. Belt tracking, billing, classes, waivers, email and SMS are included. 30-day trial with no card. Payment processing rates aren't published.
  • Kicksite: $49/mo for 0-25 students and $99/mo for 26-50, with all features at every tier and the first 30 days free. Price steps up with student count, so it's cheapest for very small schools.
  • PushPress: Free plan at $0/mo with unlimited members, but cards cost 4.99% + $0.30. Pro is $159/mo with cards at 2.89% + $0.30.

Two more we checked

BJJLink is built only for Jiu-Jitsu academies. Its Black plan is $49/mo billed monthly plus a 1% service fee, and Coral is $149/mo with no service fee. Both have unlimited students. The pricing page says these prices are for first-time customers, and there's a 30-day trial with no contract and no credit card. The page doesn't spell out what the 1% applies to (BJJLink pricing).

GymPoint is $0/mo for unlimited members if you're a U.S. gym and keep GymPoint Payments connected. Its all-in processing rates are 3.49% + 20¢ for online, card-on-file and keyed payments and 2.49% + 20¢ in person. Growth ($39/mo) and Pro ($99/mo) add AI tools, a lead pipeline and, on Pro, multiple locations; annual billing saves 20% (GymPoint pricing, processing rates). It's a general gym tool, not martial-arts specific.

What a cheap plan really costs

Take a school collecting $4,800 a month through the software (40 students at $120). Using published fees only, and before Stripe's own card fees:

  • MatGoat Professional: $60/mo, with no MatGoat percentage.
  • MatPilot Free: $0 + 2% = about $96/mo.
  • MatPilot Pro: $79 + 0.49% = about $103/mo.
  • MAAT: $59 + 1% = about $107/mo monthly, or about $97/mo on the annual plan ($49 + 1%).
  • RhinoFit Standard: $57/mo flat (its processing rates aren't published).

MatPilot Pro starts to cost less than MatPilot Free once you take about $5,230 a month through it, where 1.51 percentage points of fee savings cover the $79. GymPoint's 3.49% + 20¢ online rate already includes processing, so compare it with the platform fee plus Stripe's fee on the other tools, not with the platform fee alone.

What we couldn't confirm

Not published on vendor pages: MatPilot's Free plan member limit; annual prices for MatGoat, MatPilot and BJJLink; what BJJLink's 1% service fee is charged on; whether MAAT has parent or family accounts; and RhinoFit's processing rates. Some review sites quote a member limit for MatPilot Free, but MatPilot's own pricing page doesn't, so we don't either.

faq: What is the cheapest martial arts software?

Of the tools we checked on 2026-11-09, MatPilot Free and GymPoint Free are $0/mo (MatPilot charges a 2% platform fee on payments; GymPoint requires U.S. gyms to use GymPoint Payments at 3.49% + 20¢ online). The cheapest paid plans with published prices are MatGoat Basic at $40/mo (up to 50 students, no payment management), BJJLink Black at $49/mo plus a 1% service fee, MAAT at $49/mo paid annually plus 1%, and RhinoFit at a flat $57/mo.
Is there martial arts software with unlimited students under $80 a month?

Yes. MatGoat Professional ($60/mo), MAAT ($59/mo, or $49/mo paid annually, plus 1%), RhinoFit Standard ($57/mo), BJJLink Black ($49/mo plus a 1% service fee) and MatPilot Pro ($79/mo plus 0.49%) all publish unlimited members or students.
Does cheap martial arts software track belts?

MatPilot lists belts, stripes and promotion history per art; MatGoat lists belt and level history on both plans; MAAT tracks stripe and belt promotion readiness; RhinoFit includes belt tracking; and BJJLink lists automated belt promotions.
What extra fees do low-cost martial arts tools charge?

MatPilot adds 2% (Free) or 0.49% (Pro) on payments, MAAT adds 1%, and BJJLink Black adds a 1% service fee, all before card processing. MatGoat says it adds no percentage and you pay only Stripe's fees. GymPoint's rates of 3.49% + 20¢ online and 2.49% + 20¢ in person include processing.
